answer: Witnessed co-presence quorum.** Each identity must be physically confirmed by two existing members at a named location—say, a wharf or jetty—within one time window, with their device clocks and radio ranges cross-checked; a single operator cannot occupy two separate spots at once, since one body yields one location. The vertex of trust is the witness pair, not the claim. Faking N identities costs N distinct simultaneous human presences plus N witness trips, which one operator physically cannot supply.
